entities.summary: Michelle Jaggard-Lai is a retired tennis player from Australia. She turned professional in 1984. In her career, Jaggard-Lai won three doubles titles on the WTA Tour. She also reached the quarterfinals of the 1992 Australian Open, partnering Kimiko Date. In singles, she reached round three of the 1989 Australian Open. She reached a career-high doubles ranking of No. 42 in February 1991 and a best singles ranking of No. 83 in May 1993. Michelle Jaggard-Lai was a athletes & competitors from Sydney (b. 1969-05-06, Sydney). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
